function.name: PedicleScrewPlanner
function.description: Guided interactive workflow for PedicleScrewPlanner. Execute steps in order. Interactive steps require user 3D interaction. Steps: 'cb_step_1': In the "Spine CT" section, select the CT volume for processing.; 'cb_step_2': Click the "Next" button in the "1. Load Image Volume" page.; 'cb_step_3': Manually adjust the boundaries of the ROI. (interactive: generic); 'cb_step_4': Choose the "Instrumented Levels:". Choose the "# Sides:". Choose the "Approach Direction:".; 'cb_step_5': Click the "Next" button in the "2. Define Surgical Region of Interest (ROI)" page.; 'cb_step_6': In the toolbar, turn on "slice intersection visibility". In the slice intersection interaction options, turn on "set interaction", then enable both "Translate" and "Rotate".; 'cb_step_7': Manually adjust the rotation angle of the red slice. (interactive: generic); 'cb_step_8': Click the "Place a control point" button to activate the point placement.; 'cb_step_9': Manually click in the 2D views to add fiducial points for one part of the spine. (interactive: fiducial); 'cb_step_10': Click the "Place a control point" button to inactivate the point placement.

user_action.description: Action: 'start' to begin a step, 'proceed' after user completes interaction, 'skip' for optional steps, 'cancel' to abort workflow, 'choice_made' for user_choice steps

choice_value.description: Value selected by the user for user_choice steps. Required when user_action is 'choice_made'. A multi-selection step takes a JSON object mapping each parameter_name to its value.
